Banana Chocolate Chip Bread
By: Teresa Simanton
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:39pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup butter
1 cup sugar
1 egg
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
2 cups all-purpose flour
3 very ripe bananas
1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Cream the butter, sugar, and eggs. Separately mash bananas then mix them into the butter mixture until thoroughly mixed.  Sift together flour, baking soda, and flour. Lastly, fold in chocolate chips.  Pour mixture into well greased loaf ban. Bake for 50 -60 minutes at 350 degrees.

About


optional to add 1/2 cup finely chopped nuts in place of or in addition to chocolate chips.
